verdict_reason: GOV.UK select, MoJ sub navigation, hidden tab field, panel heading and Type column match inc-067/068 and the prototype's order; one Minor design question on Clear search when a Type filter is set.

todos.issue: No design source shows 'Clear search' when a Type filter is set. The prototype has no Clear search link (prototype-dr2-1-source-p15-013-m1, inc-063 criterion at workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/themes/address-book/backlog.json:590). The 26 October snagging ruling put it back so a trader 'gets back to the full list' (workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/snagging.md:85), but that came before the Type filter existed. The code shows the link only when a search term is set (list.njk:86) and its href keeps the Type (list.controller.js:174 clearSearchHref: addressBookPageHref(1, { addressType, role })). So with a Type and a search, 'Clear search' does not return the full tab, and with a Type alone there is no link at all.
todos.fix: Must: the designer decides how Clear search behaves while a Type filter is set, and the page follows that decision. Options for the designer: (a) keep it as built: the link appears only for a search term and keeps the Type; (b) the link clears the search and the Type, returning the whole tab; (c) the link also appears when only a Type is set, and clears it.
